bullet: Fresh Produce Market Brief – Data as of 2025-10-30**
Banana prices surged 32.98% to INR 1,470.72/quintal despite above-average arrivals (340.14 quintals, supply index 1.23), suggesting strong demand absorption.
Orange prices fell 5.73% to INR 2,608.34/quintal with elevated supply (174.2 quintals, supply index 1.24), flagged as glut condition.
Apple markets remain stable at INR 6,531.25/quintal with robust arrivals (864.66 quintals, supply index 1.84) and flat week-over-week pricing.
No commodities currently signal shortage risk; all supply indices above 1.0 indicate adequate to abundant market arrivals across monitored produce.
Recommended Action:** Increase orange procurement volumes immediately to capitalize on the 5.73% price drop and oversupply conditions before market correction.
